en.headline: Film Archive opens ticket sales for Cheng Pei-pei matinee series
en.dek: Ten films spanning romance, wuxia, kung fu and comedy screen at Sai Wan Ho from 2 October to 4 December; tickets are $40 from today on URBTIX.
body: The Hong Kong Film Archive of the Leisure and Cultural Services Department begins selling tickets today for a Morning Matinee series titled “Chivalry and Grace — In Memory of Cheng Pei-pei”.

Ten films from different stages of the actress’s career will be shown at the Archive cinema in Sai Wan Ho from 2 October to 4 December. The line-up includes the early romances The Lovers’ Rock (1964) and Song of Orchid Island (1965); Shaw Brothers wuxia titles Come Drink with Me (1966), Golden Swallow (1968) and Dragon Swamp (1969); the musical Hong Kong Nocturne (1967) and spy comedy The Purple Shell (1967); her first kung fu film None But the Brave (1973); Painted Faces (1988); and the Stephen Chow comedy Flirting Scholar (1993), in which she plays Madame Wah.

The Archive described Cheng, who died in 2024, as a “queen of wuxia” whose dance training shaped the swordswoman roles that made her name from the 1960s, and who later moved between film and television. Selected screenings will be followed by talks with Grace Ng, Eric Tsang Siu-wang, Matthew Cheng and Thomas Shin.
Tickets are $40 and go on sale from today, 5 September, on URBTIX, with telephone bookings on 3166 1288. Programme details are on the Film Archive website.

zh.headline: 電影資料館鄭佩佩回顧今起售票 十部作品10月起映
zh.dek: 「俠影翩躊──懷念鄭佩佩」由10月2日至12月4日在西灣河資料館放映，門票40元，今日起於城市售票網發售。
body: 康樂及文化事務署香港電影資料館「影畫早晨」節目「俠影翩躊──懷念鄭佩佩」今日起售票，精選鄭佩佩十部不同類型作品，10月2日至12月4日於西灣河資料館電影院放映。
片單涵蓋出道初期的愛情文藝片《情人石》（1964）和《蘭嶼之歌》（1965）；邵氏武俯片《大醉俠》（1966）、《金燕子》（1968）和《毒龍潭》（1969）；歌舞片《香江花月夜》（1967）與間諜喜劇《諜網嬌娃》（1967）；她首部功夫片《鐵娃》（1973）；《七小福》（1988）；以及周星馳喜劇《唐伯虎點秋香》（1993），她在片中飾演華夫人。
資料館形容有「武俯影后」之稱的鄭佩佩自六十年代以舞蹈底子塑造剛柔並潞的女俠形象，其後亦跨足電視。部分場次設映後談，講者包括藍天雲、曾肇弘、鄭政恆及登徒。
門票每張40元，今日（9月5日）起於城市售票網發售，電話購票3166 1288。節目詳情見資料館網頁。
